notes.title: RATMEN CAMPAIGN UPDATE!!
notes.notes:
Hi all, after a bit of waiting we have pushed another update to the Ratmen campaign. Right now, around one-third of content is playable and includes a few interesting additions like stealth missions (where your units need to remain undetected), sewers maze and Sorodon's bazaar (with obligatory drunken dwarves fight!).

We have also added a few items which improve the morphed form of heroes, e.g. Spider form of Lexa can be made quite powerful. I hope to add ever more items and work on polymorph mechanics.

We also re-numbered all campaigns as chapters so new players aren't confused about the order of campaigns. For modders - we have modified battle tasks and separate conditions can be made mandatory, e.g. it's possible to force players to open certain Treasure Chest.

Please enjoy and, as always, any feedback is welcome.

Take care,
Les & AOF Team

notes.notes:

Change log:

[list]
[*] Traps (as well as a few other special objects, e.g. cauldron, barricade, explosive barrel, etc.) can be placed without using turn. We are still tuning AI for this logic update.

[*] Slippery is less potent (10% slip chance and 30% chance of pushing away in melee).

[*] We track a few last triggered Global Events and make sure the same ones won't be triggered.

[*] AI moving invisible units is much faster (previously animation time was the same as normal move).

[*] Holy Protection attribute for Inquisitors and Valkyries. This attribute makes units immune for Necromancy and Death spells.

[*] Units with Hit and Run aren't able to attack again after retreat.

[*] Poisoned invisible units won't be revealed (till they die).

Les & AOF Team

notes.title: MUTAGEN CHANGES (AND MORE)!!
notes.notes:
Hi all, the last couple of weeks were busy as we were finalising the Ambush feature for the Age of Fear series. This is the part of wider Stealth mechanics and will be ready for the next game in the series.
To accommodate new logic, we had to refactor huge amounts of code and, among other things, we managed to cross a few things from our todo list, i.e. enhancements to traits system, deploy-turn actions and random generation of maps.

Let's start with the traits system. The common request was to give an option to remove unwanted traits - to address that we expanded the Mutagen potion functionality and, while it is still accelerating traits, it can be also used to remove them (from the Skills menu in the Recruitment screen). The Mutagen potion is also classified as a rare item now, therefore it should be more common as a loot in battles.

We have added a new class of actions which can be executed during Deploy Turn, e.g. Sea Witch can now invoke Rain or Wind, and Juggernaut Golem can invoke Earthquake. However, those skills come with a twist - instead of a mild battle disturbance, the much more nastly version can be invoked! For example, calling an Earthquake can result in a Volcano eruption! This logic will be extended in future patches.

A logic responsible for random objects placements was improved and more fair use of objects was introduced, e.g. previously there were almost three Crates spawn per battle, now it's only one and a bit, and barrels, anvils, tables, etc. are created instead.

This is quite a sizable patch and I hope everything works fine.
As usual - all feedback is welcome.

Take care,
Les & AOF Team

notes.title: THE AGE OF FEAR SERIES UPDATE
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, I hope that most of you will remain safe at home in these troubled times. We have accelerated the development of our next game in this series and I would like to provide some details.

Our testers finished the first playthrough, finding a number of bugs and other issues that we will be working on. We've also started working on the trailer, which you can see several screenshots in this post.

In addition to a completely new story and factions, the main additions to the series (in terms of new features) will be the crafting system and invisibility. We also add many other related mechanics, such as traps, weather-changing spells, and a whole set of 'detector' skills (as a counter for hidden units),. We're still on track to release in 2020 (but that's not a promise!).

The main hero of the campaign is Angela - the daughter of a former hunter known from the Blood and Moon expansion. She will set out on an expedition to solve the  murders of underground crime lords. She will be joined by Sea People and even more adventurers, for example ourcast elementalist mage. The story takes place within the lore of series, and during the story you will meet old friends from the other games. We hope to release it before the end of this year and will definitely release more messages before ^^

In the meantime, please be safe at home and avoid contact with others. Remember, it's for your own good and health.
Take care,
Les

[b]Hi everyone! After the release of Age of Fear: The Undead King Gold, we were finally able to sit down and finally bring the last remaining Forest faction to Age of Fear: The Free World.

To better balance the Forest Folk faction (and fill the gaps in their strategy), we added two additional units - War Unicorn and Fairy:[/b]

That's why the Forst Folk faction has an interesting dynamic - you have to decide which path to follow: will you depend on Evil Driders or Holy Unicorns and Fairy tandem? There are significant differences between the two and I'm really interested in how this will pan out ^^

[b]One major change in this series of patches is more love for Greenskins faction! After 72 emails (I kid you not!) exchanged with Werdi-eh wherein we discussed Greenskins, we are implementing a number of buffs for those savages.

The key challenge with this faction is that it dies a lot from ranged attacks. However, that’s Greenskins' charm and changing that, for example by adding more powerful ranged units, will make them less unique. Therefore, we went into a different direction and improved them strategically so they can cope with losses easier. More balance tweaks for Greenskins will follow.

[*][b]NEW: Djinn’s unit - the Djinn’s Lamp quest has been expended and the Djinn himself can now join you! Will you release the poor creature from its golden prison?[/b]

Welcome all!

This is a "Great Polish” update and we have updated many features just before AOF3 release.

[list]
[*][b]Menu & Battle Music[/b] (NEW FEATURE) All battles have now distinctive tracks. We have about 3 hrs of music tracks total.

[*][b]Permanent Wounds[/b] (NEW FEATURE) All our units and enemies have a chance of receiving permanent wound on every damage they take. The less HP they have, the higher chance of permanent wound. Permanent wounds can be cured outside battles but render unit unable to fight to one battle. That should add a bit to management skills.

[*][b]Potions Overhaul[/b] (UPDATED FEATURE) All units can carry two potions and potions prices have been strongly reduced. Hopefully, that will add to decision making, as with one potion everyone was buying healing stuff only. Also, potions have more fancy names.

[*][b]Attribute Descriptions[/b] (UPDATED FEATURE) All descriptions have been rewritten to a bullet-points format. Specs are now very concise.

[*][b]Roadmap[/b] Please read about our plans here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/431700/discussions/0/1470840994955086996/

[*]new portraits: Berserker, Blade Master, Bowman, Fire Archer, Footman, Ogre, War Ogre, Orc, Chieftain, Skeleton Rider, Monk, High Priest, Demonologist and Artificer, improved portraits backgrounds for castle, plains, forest

[*]new items: Amulet of Night, Tear of God, Sprite Stones, Ruby, Helmet of Haste, Potion of Invulnerability, Divine Cross, Scythe, Pitchfork :-)

[*]update: hint when enemy carries items

[*]update: Cleave indicator when unit gets free attack

[*]update: move static asserts files into aof-data.zip to reduce next patches size

[*]update: fast math optimisations to improve performance

[*]balance: free mage unit in human campaign

Welcome to GOLD update!!

[b][u]Why Gold you ask?[/u][/b]
Everyone likes Gold, right? Age of Fear 2 is a mature product. All the older art has been replaced and many interesting new features have been introduced over the last two years. Features such as morale, potions, items and more. In this release we have reached an important milestone, where all the assets were made by professionals:
[list]
[*]Story voice-overs
[*]Conversations 
[*]New story illustrations
[/list]

[b][u]Does this mean game won't be developed further?[/u][/b]
Absolutely not! Anyone that's followed our progress for some time knows that we regularly release updates and improvements for the game. We are definitely not stopping that, because it's fun for us too!

[b][u]Are both Age of Fear games Gold now?[/u][/b]
Only Age of Fear 2 has been upgraded. We have updated the voice-overs and conversations in Age of Fear 1, but there are still illustrations to re-draw. It will get it Gold status eventually, but not right now.

[b][u]It wouldn’t be possible without our dedicated players![/u][/b]

[b]As always, we ask you to spare few seconds and write a review! Reviews help us improve our game and gather more players, what gives us more resources to work on new features![/b]


All of best,

Ladies and Gentleman, Dwarves and Elves, Orcs and Goblins, Steam Players and other Zombies...

We give you, long awaited, the one and only, The Great…

[i](fanfare)[/i]

[b]WORKSHOP MANAGER![/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9162478/1486d6bd8d5c492b0e5b38c6b8d409dd4c2c3aaa.png[/img]
[i]Ugly design, isn't it?[/i]

Age of Fear engine is very flexible, but it’s not so straight-forward to mod. We have created a pdf guide (available via Workshop Manager), but it does not explain all tips and tricks. I guess it will be much easier to analyse what we have already to see what’s available 
- 4 campaigns (soon two more) plus 180+ units is a substantial sample.

Modding definitely requires some basic IT skills like editing xml files and understanding of basic scripting patterns. Some bits like easy, like units’ stats and attributes. Some bits are medium-difficulty, like campaign flow logic. And some are definitely hard and require some work, such as creating new battles (editing existing ones is way more doable).

Ask any questions on forum - I will answer the best I can. 

[b]Please take it easy!
Those are developer tools and not meant to be polished and bugs-free.  Please write some feedback - we will improve Workshop Manager in future. There is an sample:[/b]
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=898344196



Happy modding,
Les

PS.
ALWAYS have a backup of modified file.

notes.title: Update released (v4.3.1)!
notes.notes:
Hi all,


There are some visual improvements and a couple of new features:
[list]
[*]update: shop tutorial in presentation dialog
[*]update: permanent wounds can be cured (for 100 gp)
[*]update: Demon's Lover campaign has more gold (6.2k to 8.5k)
[*]update: Deathseeker/Master difficulties differ only in disabled save games and enabled permanent wounds
[*]update: Blinded is -2 Attack and -3 Ranged Attack
[*]update: Enhanced Weapon/Armour upgrades cost gold as well as experience
[*]update: Summoned imps and terrors can break free (no more summons spamming)
[*]bugfix: hidden items are not visibly targetable by area attacks (e.g. Fireball), but will be hit anyway. Once damaged, marker will show
[*]bugfix: conversations were sometimes messing up units stats (race condition)
[/list]

AOF3 is coming all together quite nicely. I have already asked for making video trailer. I am still adding more extra bits, but from our side it's just polishing story, testing and balance only (but it takes more time than you think!)

Valve has updated its shop layout and algorithms, you can read it about there:
http://www.gamasutra.com/view/news/291118/Steam_Discovery_20_analysis_Valve_shares_latest_metrics.php

Consensus between indie devs is that it lowered their sales somewhere around -25% to -30%. However, as so far we haven't been affected by this - I don't really know why. I see two explanations:
[list]
[*]AOF series has very supportive community and it's not that dependant on Steam exposure algorithms. Many thanks to all you guys!
[*]Age of Fear is quite unique product even in its own niche. There are only a handful of games with similar and most of them are quite dated and no longer developed.
[*]We have had a couple of new features released over X-Mas period and that's probably shielded us (i.e. keeping game fresh).
[/list]


Thank you guys and have a nice week!
Les

notes.title: Update released (v2.2.7)!
notes.notes:
Hi all,


Another update on the way!
New features:
- hidden treasure chests on all maps!
- ca. 20 new items for your heroes!
- new hidden ninja hero!
- controllable drag and drop sensitivity (Mouse tab in Configurations)

Bug-fixes:
- crash when Will-o-Wisp abandons its host
- error when Apple java is not completely removed from system (Mac users only)
- restoring hp on permanent enhancements
- other minor patches

Balance changes:
- will-o-wisp - the possession will work only on very close range now - so will-o-wisp has to come close first. Also it will spawn with zero magic points, so it will need 2 turns to charge.
- hellblazer - +1Attack and Unholy strength will work on it now.
- summoner/demonologist/chaosmage - they will get expensive upgrade to remove Chaos Magic.
- disintegration will do more damage now (2+x)d2, where x is level of spellcaster, so chaos mages should be more useful
- power upgrades for hellbat and giant spider (but they still say start-only units) 
- chieftain fight - I have removed goblin sappers, so it will not be so easy anymore. I will also power up Razhir so duel will not be easy anymore
- warlock summon snakes - snakes will not get level upgrade (regular/veteran/elite), but instead shaman will be able to summon more of them (2+x, where x is upgrade level)
- warlock hypnotize - will have shorter range (so warlock will be more exposed to ranged)
- troll/troll stone thrower will be more upgradeable (more HP and attack)
- ogres will have more Attack (but less defence).

Thanks to Kalis for all his input!

All of best,
Les
